title: Roadmap confidence bands & pre-mortem: Q2 exec readout prep
creator: Emily Chen
description:
Purpose: Prepare a concise, evidence-backed exec readout for Q2 that surfaces initiative confidence bands (Green/Amber/Red), clear escalation asks, and a short pre-mortem identifying top failure modes and mitigations. Include one-pager for board ops and a 10-slide deck for the exec meeting.

Scope: All roadmap initiatives with >P1 investment across runtime, Dedicated, Private, and Console surface areas. Deliverables: 1) 1-page 'confidence bands' summary per initiative, 2) aggregate heatmap showing risk concentration by team and timeline, 3) pre-mortem with top 5 failure modes and mitigations, 4) recommended exec asks (funding/heads/priority swaps), 5) slide deck and one-pager for exec packet.

Success criteria: Execs can make go/no-go decisions for prioritized bets within 20 minutes; roll-up confidence delta compared to last Q is documented; clear owner for each escalation ask.
comments: 2026-03-02 | Emily Chen: Drafted confidence band definitions (Green: >85% on-time & MTL; Amber: 60-85% w/ mitigations; Red: <60% or major external dependency). Uploaded working doc to Confluence and flagged required inputs from ENG and DES.

2026-03-04 | Marco Silva: Spoke with Runtime eng leads; primary risk for runtime-optimization initiative is kernel availability for quantized ops on target GPUs. Asked ENG to provide mitigation ETA and cost delta by 2026-03-09.
2026-03-06 | Aisha Khan (Design): Reviewed messaging for board one-pager. Proposed replacing technical lane-level metrics with user-facing latency/cost delta examples to improve exec signal clarity.
2026-03-09 | Priya Nair (Research): Shared perf regression dashboard link and suggested adding a short eval slice showing hallucination risk after quantization. See Grafana dashboard attached.

2026-03-11 | Marco Silva: Incorporated ENG feedback. Kernel availability scheduled for 2026-03-18; contingency plan is to route select traffic to a higher-fidelity model variant and enable autoscaling in Dedicated pools.

2026-03-12 | Emily Chen: First pass of slide deck complete. Slide 4 (heatmap) needs input from Platform on capacity forecast — requested ENG capacity estimate (ENG-40212) and Console cost impact (PM-827460).
2026-03-13 | Design review (DES-781): Fine-tuned one-pager layout. Requested clearer ask callouts (headcount vs budget vs SLA changes) and approval for final visual language.

2026-03-14 | Marco Silva (In Review notes): Ready for exec dry-run 2026-03-18. Outstanding: final capacity numbers from ENG (expected 2026-03-16) and legal sign-off for customer-facing language (low risk). Planned exec asks are documented in the 'asks' section of Confluence.
decision_log: 2026-03-05 | Decision: Use three-band confidence model (Green/Amber/Red) instead of numeric probabilistic estimates to simplify exec consumption.
2026-03-10 | Decision: For any initiative marked Red, default auto-trigger is a 2-week leadership sync + contingency budget hold unless mitigation shows progress.
2026-03-12 | Decision: Include 'pre-mortem' slide per initiative highlighting top 3 failure modes and assigned owners.
